Name: Family Guy Content Mod
Author: Pooepw
Description:
[size=6][color=#ff0000]Mod Overview[/color]
[/size]Peter Griffin here to explain the joke. What you are going to want to do is get Peter Seeds by taking two pieces of wood and bangin' 'em together. Then, grow 'em for 11 days. Petah Griff will appear, so slice off his head before he gets all the way out. Then, you can drink his disembodied head for sick heals! Be careful though: his blood is stronger than drain cleaner, so you will end up a bit tipsy.

[color=#ff0000][size=5]Get Help from Chris and Stewie
[/size][/color]By taking a bit of Copper and Coal, you can start bashing your enemies with the head of Chris Griffin. Don't worry; he's cool with it. Then, if you are really rich, you can take 30 Iridium bars and a bit of coal to make Stewie's Head: the ultimate dagger.

[color=#ff0000][size=5]Installation Instructions[/size][/color]
Install like you would any other Stardew Valley Mod by unzipping and then placing the mod in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
i.e.
Windows: [code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]Linux:
[code]~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley[/code]Mac:
[code]~/Library/Application Support/Steam/SteamApps/common/Stardew Valley/Contents/MacOS[/code]
Follow this if you are still confused: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley Modding Help[/url]

[size=2][color=#980000]The Meg Invasion[/color]
[/size][size=1]There have been rumors of Meg being everywhere. Just ignore her.[/size]
